name: gijiroku-mcp
description: Local Japanese meeting transcription that Claude turns into minutes, with an MCP Apps control panel. Recording continues until stopped or disconnected.
long_description: Apple Silicon Mac only. No recording starts on installation. Ask Claude to start recording explicitly; check recording_status for models, process outcomes and recent transcript. After starting model preparation, use wait_for_update with the returned revision until models.ready=true. The same tool monitors live transcript changes; timeouts do not imply completion. Use read_recording for raw events. prepare_models downloads missing models into ~/Library/Application Support/gijiroku-mcp/models. Transcripts and engine logs are saved under ~/Library/Application Support/gijiroku-mcp/claude. Includes an MCP Apps control panel for model preparation, recording controls and live text. Ask Claude to open gijiroku-mcp. Text-only clients retain all existing tools. Opening the panel never starts recording. This experimental bundle is not Developer ID signed or notarized.

tools.name: prepare_models
tools.description: Download required models, then follow wait_for_update until ready

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Record and transcribe continuously until stopped

tools.name: recording_status
tools.description: Inspect model download progress, process outcome and live transcript summary

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List saved transcription sessions across connections, including live recordings

tools.name: read_recording
tools.description: Read recording events by selected ID, or this connection's latest recording

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read a whole recording at once as plain text with timestamps and speaker labels

tools.name: list_microphones
tools.description: List the microphones start_recording can choose

tools.name: wait_for_update
tools.description: Wait up to 20 seconds for status or live transcript changes

tools.name: open_gijiroku
tools.description: Open the interactive controls and live transcription panel without starting recording
